passage.label: Whatever heavens earth exalts Allah Exalted Might Wise; His dominion heavens earth gives life causes death over all competent; First Last Ascendant Intimate of all Knowing; created heavens earth six days established above Throne knows penetrates earth emerges descends heaven ascends with you wherever Seeing; His dominion heavens earth to Allah returned matters; causes night enter day day enter night Knowing within breasts

arabicExcerpts.text: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّـٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ

هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعۡرُجُ فِيهَاۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ
لَّهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ
يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

mainSubject.label: Universal tasbih of all in heavens and earth affirming the Mighty Wise; cosmic dominion joined to giving life and causing death under universal competence; the four paired names — First and Last, Ascendant and Intimate — sealed by complete knowledge; creation in six days followed by establishment above the Throne, with knowledge of what penetrates and emerges from the earth and what descends and ascends in heaven, accompanied by His being with them wherever they are and seeing their deeds; dominion reaffirmed with all matters returning to Him; the mutual entering of night into day and day into night closing with knowledge of what the breasts contain

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the night-day interpenetration and breast-knowledge (6) before the belief-and-spending commission opens (7); P2 ends with the hypocrites' refused ransom (15) before the heart-humbling question begins (16); P3 runs through charity, worldly-life critique, the race command, the disaster register and stinginess (16-24); P4 covers the messengers-Scripture-balance-iron commission, the prophetic chain including Isa's followers, and the closing bounty-in-Allah's-hand declaration (25-29).
